title: HEPA filtration for cleanrooms and critical zones
summary: High-efficiency filters and sealed installation are prerequisites for controlled environments.
paragraphs: In cleanrooms and critical medical or lab zones, HEPA and ULPA filters capture fine particles that would otherwise threaten process or patient safety. Filter class alone is not enough — sealing, airflow direction and validation matter just as much.
Maintenance must avoid bypass around the media. Documenting differential pressure and periodic checks supports internal and external compliance.
When specifying filters, consider zone classification, air-change rates and how the facility actually operates.
